description: Search council school admissions documents (admissions booklets, allocation figures, oversubscription criteria) by topic, such as sibling priority, feeder schools or how distance is measured. Returns passages with a link to the council's document. Can be limited to one local authority.

answer.description: Also return a generated summary of the top passages in which every sentence cites a passage by its position (1 is the first). Left out when the site has no answer model or the summary fails its checks

local_authority.description: Only this council's documents (name or code)

query.description: What to look for, such as sibling priority or how distance is measured

name: search_admissions_documents
